title: Oxlintrc with @cerios/sparta-lint-rules
description: oxlint's configuration schema, extended with the sparta rules and settings.sparta. Generated by tests/oxlintrc-schema.test.ts; do not edit.

sparta/architecture-boundaries.description: Enforce the SPARTA layer and isolation boundaries between imports.
sparta/architecture-boundaries.markdownDescription:
Enforce the SPARTA layer and isolation boundaries between imports.

[Documentation](https://github.com/CeriosTesting/sparta-lint-rules/blob/main/docs/rules/architecture-boundaries.md)

sparta/class-matches-filename.description: Require a layer file to contain exactly one class, named after the file in PascalCase.
sparta/class-matches-filename.markdownDescription:

sparta/director-composes-builders.description: Require a director to compose several builders; a director using a single builder belongs on that builder.
sparta/director-composes-builders.markdownDescription:

sparta/expect-from-support.description: Require `expect` to be imported from the support module (`@sparta/support`) inside sparta/.
sparta/expect-from-support.markdownDescription:

sparta.description: Describes a SPARTA project whose names differ from the standard ones. Settings never relax the rules. See https://github.com/CeriosTesting/sparta-lint-rules#configuration
sparta.markdownDescription: Describes a SPARTA project whose names differ from the standard ones. Settings never relax the rules. See https://github.com/CeriosTesting/sparta-lint-rules#configuration

root.description: Project root: aliases resolve against it, and only paths below it are matched. A relative path resolves against the folder the linter runs in. Default: the nearest folder with a package.json.
root.markdownDescription: Project root: aliases resolve against it, and only paths below it are matched. A relative path resolves against the folder the linter runs in. Default: the nearest folder with a `package.json`.

folders.description: Names of the two top-level folders. Replaces the defaults sparta and tests.
folders.markdownDescription: Names of the two top-level folders. Replaces the defaults `sparta` and `tests`.

areas.description: Extra area folders, each following a standard area, e.g. { "web": "ui" }. Each area folder is still isolated from the others.
areas.markdownDescription: Extra area folders, each following a standard area, e.g. `{ "web": "ui" }`. Each area folder is still isolated from the others.

layers.description: Extra layer folders, each following a standard layer folder (its layer rules and file suffix), e.g. { "page-objects": "pages" }.
layers.markdownDescription: Extra layer folders, each following a standard layer folder (its layer rules and file suffix), e.g. `{ "page-objects": "pages" }`.

aliases.description: Extra path aliases pointing to the sparta or tests folder, e.g. { "@app/*": "sparta" }. Only needed when they are not in your tsconfig paths.
aliases.markdownDescription: Extra path aliases pointing to the `sparta` or `tests` folder, e.g. `{ "@app/*": "sparta" }`. Only needed when they are not in your tsconfig `paths`.

supportModule.description: The module expect must be imported from inside the sparta folder. Replaces the default @sparta/support.
supportModule.markdownDescription: The module `expect` must be imported from inside the sparta folder. Replaces the default `@sparta/support`.

pollingMethods.description: Extra retrying methods, added to toPass, toPassAndReturn, poll and pollAndReturn.
pollingMethods.markdownDescription: Extra retrying methods, added to `toPass`, `toPassAndReturn`, `poll` and `pollAndReturn`.

expectNames.description: Extra assertion functions that tests must not call, added to expect and expectly….
expectNames.markdownDescription: Extra assertion functions that tests must not call, added to `expect` and `expectly…`.

spartaSeverity.description: off/allow: off, warn: warning, error/deny: error. The sparta rules take no options.
